description: Create workflow template service for CRUD operations
steps: Implement getWorkflowTemplates(educatorId) - list all workflows with step count
Implement getWorkflowTemplate(id, educatorId) - get single with steps and template info
Implement createWorkflowTemplate(data) - create with initial steps if provided
Implement updateWorkflowTemplate(id, data) - update name, description, isActive
Implement deleteWorkflowTemplate(id, educatorId) - soft delete or hard if not assigned to courses
Implement addWorkflowStep(workflowId, stepData) - add step with order calculation
Implement updateWorkflowStep(stepId, data) - update trigger, offset, template
Implement deleteWorkflowStep(stepId) - delete and reorder remaining steps
Implement reorderWorkflowSteps(workflowId, stepIds[]) - bulk update order field

description: Create server actions for workflow CRUD operations
steps: Define Zod schemas: createWorkflowSchema, updateWorkflowSchema, workflowStepSchema
Implement createWorkflowAction(formData) - validate and call service
Implement updateWorkflowAction(id, formData) - validate ownership and update
Implement deleteWorkflowAction(id) - validate ownership and delete
Implement addStepAction(workflowId, stepData) - add step to workflow

description: Create trigger selector component for workflow steps
steps: Accept props: triggerType, triggerOffset, triggerClassIndex, onChange callbacks
Create Select for trigger type with options: course_start, course_end, exam_date, class_date, registration_deadline
Create Input for offset with label 'días' and radio/toggle for 'antes/después' (negative/positive)
Conditionally show Input for class index when triggerType is 'class_date'
Display human-readable summary (e.g., '3 días antes del inicio del curso')
Use shadcn Select, Input, Label, RadioGroup components
Accept props: step data, templates list, onUpdate, onDelete, dragHandleProps
Add Select for email template selection with template name preview
Add delete button with confirmation (use AlertDialog)
Style as Card with visual hierarchy
Add drag handle icon (GripVertical from lucide-react) for reordering
Accept props: steps array with trigger info and template names
Display vertical timeline with connected nodes
Each node shows: trigger description, template name, offset
Use relative positioning for visual flow
Handle empty state with placeholder message

description: Create workflow form component with step builder
steps: Accept props: initialData (for edit), templates list, onSubmit action
Use react-hook-form with Zod resolver for validation
Manage steps array in form state
Add 'Agregar paso' button that adds new step with defaults
Implement drag-and-drop reordering with @dnd-kit/core (or simple up/down buttons as fallback)
Add Submit button with loading state
Create src/app/educator/workflows/page.tsx as async Server Component
Get educatorId from session, redirect if not authenticated
Display Table with columns: Nombre, Descripción, Pasos, Cursos asignados, Estado, Acciones
Get educatorId from session, redirect if not authenticated
Fetch templates using getTemplates service for dropdown
Get workflowId from params, educatorId from session
Fetch workflow using getWorkflowTemplate, return 404 if not found
Render WorkflowForm with workflow data as initialData
